== Summary ==
Slip “Hyperoute Navigation Chart” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-P.pdf Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)] (PDF file created 12 December 2022), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 108, 1102, 830)). Version [[Hyperoute Navigation Chart (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
